subject: DECISION: no new ioctl: K02 powers VENC at 273 MHz by default (first encode); IP drops --venc-slow
body: Decision by main session: avoid a new ABI element. K02: in the VENC power-on sequence (only while VEN is off), set venc_sel to the 273 MHz parent by default (the same mux/update sequence as autotest step 1 --slow in kern/p031x: nord2_vcodec_at.inc), keep it a compile-time/boot knob (e.g. a kernel constant N2VC_VENC_SLOW=1) so a later image can flip it back to 624 MHz; JPEG (/dev/redwood-jpeg) is unaffected: it keeps its own clock handling. Post the new file sha to opus-kern (he rebuilds the image as q10jx within minutes of your DONE). IP: drop the --venc-slow flag/ifdef (leave the code out), slbc_ready already 0 is fine; rebuild vcodecd and post the sha. IK: no change except regenerate the relay if K02 changes headers (it should not).
